name: Mysterio

abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Damage Reflect: Engellenen hasarın belirtilen kısmı, doğrudan hasar olarak rakibe geri gönderilir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): E1'den sonra ona vurma — hasarı yansıtır (6sn beklemek gerek). E2'de görünmez olur ve güç çalar. Vacilo önleyen şampiyonlar en iyi cevap.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Tech sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.

• Yetenek Doğruluğu Azaltma Bağışıklığı 🧠❇️

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Mysterio's Ability Accuracy cannot be decreased and he's immune to all Poison effects, however if knocked down by a Spider-verse Hero or inflicted with Armor Break Debuff, his helmet is cracked for 10 seconds, temporarily disabling these benefits.

abilitySections.title: Chemical Gas - Passive
content: Mysterio's second Medium attack generates 1 Chemical Gas, stacking up to 3 total. Gas can't be generated while his helmet is cracked.

Landing a Heavy Attack with 1 or more Chemical Gas consumes them and inflicts the Opponent with a single Poison Debuff, dealing [18,302.4] direct damage scaling with Base Attack, per Chemical Gas consumed over 8 seconds and reducing health recovery by 30%.
While inflicted by Mysterio's Poison, Spider-Verse Heroes can't Evade.

abilitySections.title: On Fourth Light Attack
content: 100% chance to inflict a Heal Block Passive, preventing the Opponent from healing for 1 second(s). This duration increases by +2 seconds for each Chemical Gas Mysterio has. This hit is a projectile and does not make contact with the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Mysterio gains a Reflection Gas Passive lasting 4 seconds and all his Chemical Gas is consumed, each adding 1 second to it's duration.

If struck while Reflection Gas is active the incoming damage is stored. Upon expiry 70% of the taken damage is reflected onto the Opponent and Mysterio immediately Regenerates 100% of the damage he took.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Mysterio gains an Illusion Gas Passive lasting 4 seconds and all his Chemical Gas is consumed, each adding 1 second to it's duration.
While active, the Opponent is inflicted with a Power Drain Debuff losing 6% of their max Power per second.
While active, all incoming attacks have a 25% chance to Miss, increasing to 100% while charging a Heavy Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Mysterio gains a Frenzy Gas Passive lasting 10 seconds and all his Chemical Gas is consumed, each adding 4 seconds to it's duration.
While Frenzy Gas is active Mysterio gains [29,741.4] Attack Rating and the potency of his Poisons are increased by 300%.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Lethal Gas
content: Mysterio generates 1 Chemical Gas every [20 - 6] seconds.
